name: Red Rambo - Spectrum
description_md: Mel from _Rob's Gaming Table_ provided a casual player's playthrough of this deck in their Mad Titan's Shadow Campaign! - _Check it out! -> [Rob's Gaming Table - The Mad Titan's Shadow Playthrough #1](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eZDzfIIhWJg&t=9666s)_ ___ **_"First Blood: Part II"_ (Revised):** - Subtract: [Jarnbjorn](/card/06019) - Add: [Ready to Rumble](/card/21022) _____ **Overview:** - This deck puts out massive amounts of cost-effective damage while capitalizing off of Spectrum's versatility to manage everything else. Once set up you'll easily defeat the villain in one turn -- I've beaten scenarios only a few turns in. - You'll utilize Energy Duplication to get at will with [Gamma](/card/21002), as well as [Martial Prowess](/card/10018), [Quincarrier](/card/08023), [The Power of Aggression](/card/01055), and x14 & x8. - All of those will allow you to play [Drop Kick](/card/10014), [Surprise Attack](/card/13014), [Thor](/card/13011), [Hulk](/card/01050), [Blade](/card/21019), and damage for [Jarnbjorn](/card/06019). - I've tested this deck on Expert/Heroic and won with relative ease on most scenarios. Of course Heroic is more challenging, it always is, but I've breezed through Expert playtesting. _____ **Strategy:** *Cost-Effective Damage* - You're able to shell out massive amounts of damage with all of the cards that help you reduce cost like [Deft Focus](/card/16024), [Martial Prowess](/card/10018), and [Team-Building Exercise](/card/12024). - That means: [Gamma Blast](/card/21007) for 1, [Surprise Attack](/card/13014) for 0, [Dive Bomb](/card/17028) for 2. *Set-Up* - [Deft Focus](/card/16024) works with just about every one of Spectrum's cards including Energy Duplication, [Gamma Blast](/card/21007), and [Photon Speed](/card/21008). Getting this in your starting hand is huge, which will allow you to play Energy Duplications for 1 to get your setup even faster. - Once you're set up you're using [Team-Building Exercise](/card/12024) and [Avengers Tower](/card/03024) to play allies for cheap. [Deft Focus](/card/16024) to play your Superpower Events. [Gamma Blast](/card/21007), [Surprise Attack](/card/13014), [Dive Bomb](/card/17028), and [Jarnbjorn](/card/06019) for massive cheap damage. *Card Combos* - [Deft Focus](/card/16024) + Energy Duplication / [Gamma](/card/21002) / [Photon Speed](/card/21008) - [Speed of Light](/card/21010) / [Blue Marvel](/card/21005) + [Surprise Attack](/card/13014) / [Martial Prowess](/card/10018) - [Drop Kick](/card/10014) + [Martial Prowess](/card/10018) / Energy Duplications - [Team-Building Exercise](/card/12024) + [Dive Bomb](/card/17028) / [Avengers Mansion](/card/01091) / [Avengers Tower](/card/03024) & Avenger Allies - [Quincarrier](/card/08023) for a whenever you need it. - Power-up your allies like [Thor](/card/13011), [Valkyrie](/card/06012), & [Wasp](/card/13012), who can use Energy Duplication to increase their designated resource. - [Hulk](/card/01050) & [Blade](/card/21019) benefit from all the . All allies are Avengers for [Team-Building Exercise](/card/12024) & [Avengers Tower](/card/03024). *Mulligan* - [Deft Focus](/card/16024), Energy Duplications, Resources, set-up cards and lower-cost ally for chump block and a THW/ATK. [Drop Kick](/card/10014) is also fairly easy to get the stun/draw with so many . _______ ### ***Hope you have as much fun with this deck as I do!
